basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT), New Delhi, Across India, has invited applications for 8 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. 07/355/2026/NDL/FM. The posts include Sr. System Analyst 1-(C) MHHT, Sr. System Analyst 2-(C) MHHT, Sr. System Analyst 3-Kol- (C) KMR2, Sr. Programmer 1-Kol- (C) KMR2 and 4 more. The online application is open from 30 October 2026 to 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: NIELIT Job Description
content_sections.text: The technical skill sets and job profiles required for respective posts are as follows: Sr. System Analyst 1-(C) MHHT: PL/SQL, PostgreSQL, RED HATLINUX, DBA, Info-Sec Audit and Compliance, SIEM log analysis, root cause analysis. Sr. System Analyst 2-(C) MHHT: JAVA, J2EE, SPRINGMVC, HIBERNATE, Eclipse/Netbeans/Jboss Developer Studio/STS, Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, JavaScript/Ajax/Jquery/Angular Js/Json/CSS, HTML5. Sr. System Analyst 3-Kol- (C) KMR2: Expertise in AFCPC devices/subsystems. Sr. Programmer 1-Kol- (C) KMR2: J2EE, ORACLE, Spring Boot, Jboss/WebSphere/WebLogic Application Server. Sr. Programmer 2-Kol- (C) KMR2: Android Studio, Flutter and Dart. Sr. Programmer 3-Kol- (C) KMR2: Perimeter Network security devices viz. Firewall /IPS /UTM, IPSec/SSL based network security devices/VPN, System Administrator. Sr. Programmer 4-(C) SM2S & Programmer – (C) SM2S: JAVA, J2EE, ORACLE, PL/SQL, MySql, Postgre SQL, JavaScript/Ajax/Jquery/Angular Js/Json/CSS, Python with Django framework, Flutter and Dart, Node JS with Loopback 3/4, Express JS and JWT authentication, RESTful APIs and tools like Postman or REST Assured.
